text.markup:
**Once per Turn Action** -- Turn a face down card in your arsenal face up: **Opt 1**. **Go again**
**Arcane Barrier 1** _(If your hero would be dealt arcane damage, you may pay {r} instead. If you do, prevent 1 arcane damage that source would deal.)_
**Blade Break** _(If you defend with Skullbone Crosswrap, destroy it when the combat chain closes.)_
